headline.purpose: Page-level headings across sign-in, verification, status, and dashboards.

body.purpose: Readable system sans-serif copy and controls.

label.purpose: Field labels and short control descriptors.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Subtle hover and active feedback on buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single prominent action on a page, including sign in and OTP verification.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.9rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.65rem 1.05rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.35rem; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); color: #fff; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An outlined secondary action such as resending a code or signing out.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.9rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.65rem 1.05rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0.35rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); background: #f7f8f9; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled school email, password, or verification-code input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="school-email">School email</label><input class="ds-field-input" id="school-email" type="email" autocomplete="username">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.45rem; color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0.35rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid rgb(146 43 55 / 24%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Authentication Surface
components.description: The only elevated container: a single focused sign-in or verification form.
components.css: .ds-auth-surface { padding: 2.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-auth-surface h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-auth-surface p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: School Masthead
components.description: A home link pairing the unchanged school seal with the institution and branch names.
components.html:
ARKTIESIIS
Ark Technological Institute Education System Incorporated
Lucena Branch
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-brand img { display: block; width: 4.25rem; height: 4.25rem; object-fit: contain; } .ds-brand strong { font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.045em; } .ds-brand span { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.84rem; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a clear, restrained school-office workspace. The official seal and the Lucena Branch building photograph place the pages in their real institutional setting; consistent type and form controls keep sign-in and verification easy to scan. Surfaces stay cool and neutral, with crimson used for the action and focus moments that need attention. The interface states only what is present: role dashboards remain placeholders until their tools exist.
keyCharacteristics: The school seal and building image are authentic identity assets, not decoration.
Red is reserved for primary actions, small links, and keyboard focus.
System sans-serif typography, flat surfaces, and readable form spacing carry across every page.
Role dashboards describe their current placeholder state without invented counts or navigation.

rules.name: The One Crimson Rule
rules.body: Keep large areas neutral; use crimson where a person acts, focuses, or needs to notice an error.

dos: Do use the official seal without changing its image contents.
Do keep the red accent for actions, links, focus, and error states.
Do use the supplied building photograph as the homepage's main visual.
Do preserve CSRF fields, route names, field names, and escaped EJS content when updating these forms.
Do label future dashboard work as unavailable in this build until it exists.
donts: Don't invent dashboard tools, counts, or role navigation.
Don't replace the institutional images with generic school or campus imagery.
Don't add a saturated secondary palette, gradients, or decorative shadows.
Don't expose raw authentication, database, or SMTP error details in page copy.
